signature.name: VTask.restr
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u} -> {G : Type wG} -> {G' : Type wG'} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup G'] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 G'] -> {k n : ℕ} -> (f : G [×n]→L[𝕜] G') -> (s : Finset (Fin n)) -> (hk : s.card = k) -> (z : G) -> G [×k]→L[𝕜] G'

conventions.statement: The identification between `Fin k` and `s` used when evaluating `f.restr s hk z` at a tuple `m : Fin k → G` is the unique order-preserving (increasing) bijection `s.orderIsoOfFin hk : Fin k ≃o s`.
conventions.note: Variables not in s receive the value z; variables in s receive m applied to their rank in the increasing enumeration of s.

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} {G : Type*} {G' : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] [SeminormedAddCommGroup G'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G'] {k n : ℕ} (f : G [×n]→L[𝕜] G') (s : Finset (Fin n)) (hk : s.card = k) (z : G), ‖VTask.restr f s hk z‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖z‖ ^ (n - k)
